lines.zh: 靴子踩过湿草，我走得很稳。
lines.en: Boots press through wet grass; my stride stays steady.

lines.zh: 我沿着村子外圈走，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I walk the village perimeter, round after round.

lines.zh: 风里有血味，我立刻改了方向。
lines.en: Blood on the wind; I change direction at once.

lines.zh: 我的灯只照亮三步，但够了。
lines.en: My lamp lights three paces; that is enough.

lines.zh: 盐袋在腰间晃，发出细响。
lines.en: The salt pouch swings at my hip with a fine hiss.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可从不绕路。
lines.en: My pace is slow, but I take no detours.

lines.zh: 圣水在瓶里晃，我不敢跑。
lines.en: Holy water sloshes in the vials; I dare not run.

lines.zh: 今晚我已经换了三次路线。
lines.en: Tonight I have already changed my route three times.

lines.zh: 门前撒一圈盐，再往下走。
lines.en: A ring of salt at the door, then on to the next.

lines.zh: 我的影子总比我先到墙角。
lines.en: My shadow always reaches the corner before I do.

lines.zh: 棺材板的声音，我一听就知道。
lines.en: I can tell the sound of a coffin lid at once.

lines.zh: 我不进村，只在外头守着。
lines.en: I do not enter the village; I keep watch outside.

lines.zh: 我靠着墙，手里还握着木桩。
lines.en: I lean on the wall, the stake still in my hand.

lines.zh: 大蒜的味道，我已经闻不出了。
lines.en: I can no longer smell the garlic on me.

lines.zh: 书翻到那一页，我看了很多遍。
lines.en: The book lies open there; I have read it many times.

lines.zh: 血瓶凉了，贴着我的腿。
lines.en: The blood vial has gone cold against my thigh.

lines.zh: 我在数还剩下几瓶圣水。
lines.en: I am counting how many holy waters I have left.

lines.zh: 风停了，这种安静最危险。
lines.en: The wind has stopped; this quiet is the most dangerous.

lines.zh: 我把盐抹在袖口，防着被咬。
lines.en: I rub salt into my cuff against bites.

lines.zh: 手上的旧疤又开始痒了。
lines.en: The old scar on my hand is itching again.

lines.zh: 休息的时候，我也背对着墙。
lines.en: Even when resting, I keep my back to the wall.

lines.zh: 这一行做久了，睡不深。
lines.en: Too long in this trade; I never sleep deeply.

lines.zh: 你走近，我先看你的牙。
lines.en: You come closer; I look at your teeth first.

lines.zh: 眼睛不红，不像那东西。
lines.en: Your eyes are not red. Not one of them.

lines.zh: 别动，把两只手摊开给我看。
lines.en: Keep still and show me both your palms.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，很干净。
lines.en: The smell on you is clean.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我出手很快。
lines.en: Do not come too close; I strike quickly.

lines.zh: 我在看你的影子动没动。
lines.en: I am watching whether your shadow moves.

lines.zh: 活人还是别的，我一眼就分。
lines.en: Living or otherwise, I tell at a glance.

lines.zh: 袖子卷起来，我要看手腕。
lines.en: Roll up your sleeve; I want to see your wrist.

lines.zh: 你不是我要找的，先走吧。
lines.en: You are not the one I seek; move along.

lines.zh: 我会盯着你，直到你出了视线。
lines.en: I will watch you until you leave my sight.

lines.zh: 它的牙进了我的肩，很深。
lines.en: Its teeth go deep into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我闷哼一声，没有退。
lines.en: One grunt, and my boots stay planted.

lines.zh: 血顺着袖子流到手背上。
lines.en: Blood runs down my sleeve onto the back of my hand.

lines.zh: 这一拳把我的气全打散了。
lines.en: The hit scatters all the air from my lungs.

lines.zh: 我按住伤口，继续举桩。
lines.en: I press the wound and keep the stake raised.

lines.zh: 还疼，说明我这条命还没完。
lines.en: Pain is good; it means I am alive.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖软了一下，又站稳。
lines.en: My knee buckles once, then holds.

lines.zh: 护甲裂了，我知道差多少。
lines.en: The armor split; I know how close that was.

lines.zh: 它打中的是我从前的旧伤。
lines.en: It struck my old wound.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把血咽回去。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and swallow the blood back.

lines.zh: 血瓶？你是从哪儿弄来的？
lines.en: A blood vial? Where did you get that?

lines.zh: 这个价钱，我可以听你说完。
lines.en: At that price, I will hear you out.

lines.zh: 终极圣水不换，别问了。
lines.en: The ultimate holy water is not for trade. Do not ask.

lines.zh: 你把大蒜举这么高，是想驱我？
lines.en: Holding the garlic up like that, are you warding me off?

lines.zh: 我闻到了，那瓶不是猪血。
lines.en: I smell it; that vial is not pig's blood.

lines.zh: 东西放下，退后三步。
lines.en: Put it on the ground and back off.

lines.zh: 我不收钱，只收线索。
lines.en: I take no coin, only information.

lines.zh: 谁的血，你先说清楚。
lines.en: Whose blood is it? Tell me that first.

lines.zh: 我的手已经放在腰带上了。
lines.en: My hand is already on my belt.

lines.zh: 别用那个跟我换命。
lines.en: Do not try to trade that for your life.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的手先护住瓶子。
lines.en: You bump into me; my hand guards the vials first.

lines.zh: 别挤，盐撒了很麻烦。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; spilled salt is a nuisance.

lines.zh: 我退半步，把木桩换到右手。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and shift the stake to my right hand.

lines.zh: 这一撞，腰上的书都响了。
lines.en: The knock rattles the book at my hip.

lines.zh: 你身上没有血味，很好。
lines.en: No blood smell on you. Good.

lines.zh: 我们错身过去，谁也没停。
lines.en: We pass each other; neither of us stops.

lines.zh: 离我一臂远，这是规矩。
lines.en: One arm's length from me. That is the rule.

lines.zh: 我的手肘顶到了你，抱歉。
lines.en: My elbow caught you. Apologies.

lines.zh: 撞这一下，我的灯晃了。
lines.en: That bump set my lamp swinging.

lines.zh: 别在我背后走，绕到前面来。
lines.en: Do not walk behind me; come round to the front.

lines.zh: 我这样的人，不留人过夜。
lines.en: Men like me do not keep anyone overnight.

lines.zh: 她也撒盐，我们就这么认识了。
lines.en: She salted her doors too; that is how we met.

lines.zh: 两盏灯并排走，比一盏安心。
lines.en: Two lamps walking side by side beat one.

lines.zh: 我把最后一瓶圣水给了她。
lines.en: I gave her my last vial of holy water.

lines.zh: 她说我手上的疤太多了。
lines.en: She said I have too many scars on my hands.

lines.zh: 天亮前我们就分开，各守一边。
lines.en: We part before dawn, each guarding a side.

lines.zh: 这行的人聚在一起，反而危险。
lines.en: In this trade, gathering together is what gets you killed.

lines.zh: 我替她磨过木桩，她替我补衣。
lines.en: I sharpened her stakes; she mended my coat.

lines.zh: 我们没说过以后，也不需要。
lines.en: We never spoke of later; we do not need to.

lines.zh: 她走过的那条路，我还会去。
lines.en: The road she took, I still walk.

lines.zh: 地上有枚木桩，我捡起来收好。
lines.en: A stake on the ground; I pick it up and stow it.

lines.zh: 这瓶盐还是满的，留着。
lines.en: This salt vial is still full; I keep it.

lines.zh: 碎掉的圣水瓶，我不捡。
lines.en: A broken holy water flask; I leave it.

lines.zh: 书页撕了，我用布包起来。
lines.en: The page is torn; I wrap it in cloth.

lines.zh: 有人掉了血瓶，瓶口还封着。
lines.en: Someone dropped a blood vial, its seal still intact.

lines.zh: 我把它擦干净，塞进内袋。
lines.en: I wipe it clean and tuck it into an inner pocket.

lines.zh: 这枚护符，我认得它的主人。
lines.en: This amulet; I know its owner.

lines.zh: 太重了，我只带走一样。
lines.en: Too heavy; I take only one thing.

lines.zh: 捡东西时，眼睛还看着路口。
lines.en: As I pick it up, my eyes stay on the crossroads.

lines.zh: 留着吧，也许今晚用得上。
lines.en: Keep it; I may need it tonight.

lines.zh: 它的影子先动，我的手后动。
lines.en: Its shadow moves first; my hand moves after.

lines.zh: 吸血鬼，站着别动。
lines.en: Vampire. Stand where you are.

lines.zh: 你从棺材里出来，我等你很久了。
lines.en: You came out of the coffin; I have waited long for this.

lines.zh: 这一片村子，归我守。
lines.en: This stretch of village is mine to guard.

lines.zh: 木桩已经削好了。
lines.en: The stake is already sharpened.

lines.zh: 红眼睛，尖牙，够了。
lines.en: Red eyes, pointed teeth. That is enough.

lines.zh: 我记住你胸口的形状。
lines.en: I note the shape of your chest.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉，这一带的路我熟。
lines.en: You will not get away; I know these roads.

lines.zh: 它动了，我也就动了。
lines.en: It moved, so I moved.

lines.zh: 先断它的退路，再动手。
lines.en: Cut off its retreat first, then strike.

lines.zh: 血味太浓，你藏不住了。
lines.en: The blood smell is too thick; you cannot hide.

lines.zh: 今晚不多杀，只杀你一个。
lines.en: Not many kills tonight; only you.

lines.zh: 我认得这种披风。
lines.en: I know that cloak.

lines.zh: 别装成活人，我听不见心跳。
lines.en: Do not play at being alive; I hear no heartbeat.

lines.zh: 它的牙露在外面，太急
lines.en: It shows its fangs too eagerly.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，绕到它背后。
lines.en: I move along the wall to come up behind it.

lines.zh: 它一回头，我就停下。
lines.en: It turns its head; I stop.

lines.zh: 手里的木桩换了三次角度。
lines.en: The stake in my hand has changed angle three times.

lines.zh: 我不喊，一喊它就跑了。
lines.en: I do not shout; a shout sends it running.

lines.zh: 盐圈撒好了，它出不去。
lines.en: The salt ring is laid; it cannot leave.

lines.zh: 它数我的心跳，我数它的步子。
lines.en: It counts my heartbeat; I count its steps.

lines.zh: 再转一圈，就贴到它侧面。
lines.en: One more turn and I reach its flank.

lines.zh: 圣水瓶的塞子已经拔了。
lines.en: The stopper is already out of the holy water.

lines.zh: 它每退一格，我就进一步。
lines.en: Every block it retreats, I take one.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸压得很浅。
lines.en: I keep my breathing very shallow.

lines.zh: 它怕光，我往火把那边赶。
lines.en: It fears light; I herd it toward the torch.

lines.zh: 别急，等它先扑上来。
lines.en: Do not rush; wait for it to lunge first.

lines.zh: 这一圈里，只有我们两个。
lines.en: In this circle there are only the two of us.

lines.zh: 我数到三，就出手。
lines.en: I count to three, then strike.

lines.zh: 我把木桩反握，贴着手臂
lines.en: I reverse the stake, held along my arm.

lines.zh: 它闻得到盐，就不敢快走
lines.en: It smells the salt and dares not rush.

lines.zh: 它转身的瞬间，我前进一步
lines.en: The instant it turns, I step in.

lines.zh: 这一条巷子只有一个口
lines.en: This alley has only one mouth.

lines.zh: 它数我的脚步，我就慢下来
lines.en: It counts my steps, so I slow down.

lines.zh: 我踢开一块瓦，让它听见
lines.en: I kick loose a tile so it hears me.

lines.zh: 木桩对准胸口，一下到底。
lines.en: The stake finds the chest and goes all the way in.

lines.zh: 我侧身避开它的爪子。
lines.en: I turn my shoulder aside from its claws.

lines.zh: 圣水泼出去，它皮肤冒白烟。
lines.en: Holy water splashes out and its skin smokes white.

lines.zh: 它咬在我的护臂上，没咬穿。
lines.en: It bites my bracer and does not get through.

lines.zh: 我反手一记，砸在它下颌。
lines.en: I swing backhand and catch it on the jaw.

lines.zh: 盐撒进伤口，它叫得很难听。
lines.en: Salt into the wound; its scream is ugly.

lines.zh: 我被推开两步，鞋跟刮着地。
lines.en: I am shoved back two paces, heels scraping the ground.

lines.zh: 这一刀偏了，只划破披风。
lines.en: The blade slips and only tears the cloak.

lines.zh: 它抓我的脸，我抬手去挡。
lines.en: It rakes at my face; I raise my arm.

lines.zh: 我的血滴下来，它盯住了。
lines.en: My blood drips, and it fixes on it.

lines.zh: 第二下，我打在它膝盖上。
lines.en: The second blow lands on its knee.

lines.zh: 它退我追，不给它换气。
lines.en: It retreats, I follow, giving it no breath.

lines.zh: 收手的时候，我的手在抖。
lines.en: When I pull back, my hand is shaking.

lines.zh: 还站着？那就再来一次。
lines.en: Still standing? Then we do it again.

lines.zh: 我抬高木桩，正对它的心口
lines.en: I raise the stake level with its heart.

lines.zh: 它扑空了，撞上我的肩
lines.en: It lunges wide and hits my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我按住它的手腕，钉在墙上
lines.en: I pin its wrist to the wall.

lines.zh: 圣水洒开，我的手套冒烟
lines.en: The holy water splashes and my glove smokes.

lines.zh: 我在这片林子里守了三天。
lines.en: I have watched this wood for three days.

lines.zh: 村里的钟响过，我就来了。
lines.en: The village bell rang; that is why I came.

lines.zh: 腰上挂了八瓶，够用了。
lines.en: Eight vials at my belt; enough for the work.

lines.zh: 有人出钱，有人求我，我都接。
lines.en: Some pay me, some beg me; I take both.

lines.zh: 上一个猎人没有回来。
lines.en: The hunter before me did not come back.

lines.zh: 我把盐袋系紧，天快黑了。
lines.en: I cinch the salt pouch; night is coming.

lines.zh: 我检查了木桩，每一根都是干的。
lines.en: I checked the stakes; every one is dry.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过一次，记得住。
lines.en: I have walked this road once and remember it.

lines.zh: 灯点上，影子也就有了。
lines.en: Light the lamp and the shadows come too.

lines.zh: 他们说我撑不过一个月。
lines.en: They said I would not last a month.

lines.zh: 我从不问雇主为什么。
lines.en: I never ask an employer why.

lines.zh: 村子还在，我就还在。
lines.en: As long as the village stands, so do I.

lines.zh: 书我背下来了，用不上也得背。
lines.en: I memorized the book, needed or not.

lines.zh: 开始吧，天亮前要收工。
lines.en: Let us begin; I want this done before dawn.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的袖子，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my sleeve; I slap it twice.

lines.zh: 从屋顶摔下来，我先护住瓶子。
lines.en: Falling from the roof, I shield the vials first.

lines.zh: 水里我看不清，木桩也慢了。
lines.en: Underwater I cannot see, and my stake slows.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，碎了一瓶圣水。
lines.en: The blast flips me and one holy water shatters.

lines.zh: 箭射进我的腿，是它的人。
lines.en: An arrow in my leg; one of its people.

lines.zh: 它的咒语掐住了我的喉咙。
lines.en: Its spell closes on my throat.

lines.zh: 两天没进食，指头先发起抖来。
lines.en: Two days without a meal and my fingers start to tremble.

lines.zh: 雷落在我旁边，耳朵嗡了半天。
lines.en: Lightning lands beside me; my ears ring for a long while.

lines.zh: 虚空吞了我，瓶子先不见了。
lines.en: The void takes me; the vials vanish first.
